title: The Safety Relay in Roleplay Jailbreaks: A Component-Resolved Causal Analysis of Harm Recognition and Refusal
abstract: arXiv:2608.30585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models are trained to follow instructions while refusing harmful requests. Jailbreaks exploit this balance to elicit content a model would ordinarily reject. Roleplay jailbreaks are especially concerning: the harmful request can remain visible inside a roleplay wrapper made of a persona, scenario, and task, yet the model may comply. We use mechanistic interpretability to determine how this context reverses refusal and which elements contribute to the reversal. Across two benchmarks, three model families, and four authored wrappers, we compare matched harmful and benign requests with and without this wrapper. We trace hidden-state contrasts from the request to the final prompt state, isolate wrapper operations through controlled counterfactuals, intervene on their activation directions in held-out evaluation requests, and decompose effective directions geometrically. translated_title: 角色扮演越狱中的安全接力：对危害识别与拒绝的组件级因果分析
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型被训练为在遵循指令的同时拒绝有害请求。越狱攻击正是利用这种平衡来诱导模型输出其通常会拒绝的内容。角色扮演越狱尤其令人担忧：有害请求可以在由人设、场景和任务构成的角色扮演包装中保持完全可见，但模型却可能服从。我们使用机制可解释性方法来确定这种上下文如何逆转拒绝行为，以及哪些元素促成了这种逆转。我们在两个基准、三个模型家族和四种自建包装上进行实验，比较匹配的有害与良性请求在有包装和无包装情况下的表现。我们追踪从请求到最终提示状态的隐状态对比，通过受控反事实隔离包装操作，在留出的评估请求中对其激活方向进行干预，并从几何角度分解有效方向。我们的分析得出三项发现。(1) 成功的攻击……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究运用机制可解释性方法，通过追踪隐状态、反事实干预和几何分解，揭示了角色扮演包装中的人设、场景和任务组件如何在组件层面逆转大语言模型的有害识别与拒绝机制。
en_tdlr: Using mechanistic interpretability—hidden-state tracing, counterfactual interventions, and geometric decomposition—this study identifies which components of roleplay wrappers (persona, scenario, task) causally reverse harm recognition and refusal in large language models at the component level.
